skill.description: Create 45-90 second software product demos as editable HTML and MP4 files with music. Show reconstructed interface workflows with smooth camera movement and branded closing scenes.
skill.summary: Build 45-90 second product explainer videos as editable HTML and render MP4 files with music and motion blur.
skill.author: barty-bart

security_audit.summary: Most static alerts are Markdown formatting, expected rendering operations, or audio serialization; no evidence of credential theft or prompt injection was found. Confirmed risks involve deleting existing frame directories and injecting entries through unescaped FFmpeg manifest paths. A separate semantic finding identifies unnecessary cross-file browser access when rendering untrusted HTML.

remediation.issue: Contact sheet cleanup recursively deletes a predictable directory that may already contain unrelated files.
remediation.suggestion: Create a unique temporary directory with mkdtemp and remove only that directory after rendering.

remediation.issue: Output-derived paths enter an FFmpeg concat manifest without escaping quotes or rejecting newlines.
remediation.suggestion: Use generated segment names in a private directory, reject control characters, escape manifest paths, and enable FFmpeg safe mode.

remediation.issue: Chromium enables cross-file access for every rendered HTML page.
remediation.suggestion: Remove the cross-file access flag; serve approved assets from an isolated local origin and block unexpected network requests.

semantic_findings.title: Unnecessary Cross-File Browser Access
semantic_findings.description: Chromium launches with --allow-file-access-from-files before loading the selected local HTML. Untrusted page scripts could read other local files and disclose accessible data.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The flag explicitly relaxes local-file origin restrictions, and no request filtering is configured. Exploitation requires untrusted rendered HTML; no malicious page is included.

content.user_title: Create Product Explainer Videos with Music
content.value_statement: Software teams need clear product demonstrations without recording every interface interaction. This skill guides editable HTML animations and MP4 rendering with music and motion blur.
actual_capabilities: Plans 45-90 second videos with timed scripts, feature chapters, and closing scenes.
Guides rebuilding product interface moments using supplied details or a product website.
Defines deterministic HTML animation with scrubbing, seeded randomness, and time-based camera movement.
Provides a Playwright and FFmpeg renderer for contact sheets, drafts, and motion-blurred MP4 output.
Supports synthesized music or supplied tracks through Web Audio and normalizes exported audio.
Supports landscape and portrait layouts, plus a silent video export.
limitations: Requires Node.js, FFmpeg, Playwright, and Chromium; these dependencies are not bundled.
Final rendering can take 20-60 minutes on a laptop, depending on quality settings.
Interface scenes are reconstructions, not recordings of a working product.
Renderer hardening is needed for untrusted HTML, crafted output paths, and existing frame directories.

use_cases.title: Prepare a Product Launch
use_cases.description: Turn an approved product brief into a one-minute launch demonstration with branded interface scenes and a closing call to action.

use_cases.title: Explain a Feature Workflow
use_cases.description: Show several interface steps with readable labels, cursor actions, and timed results without recording a live application.

use_cases.title: Build Editable Motion Assets
use_cases.description: Create a deterministic HTML animation, review contact sheets, and refine the draft before exporting a motion-blurred final video.

prompt_templates.title: Start a Simple Demo
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a 60-second explainer for [product] using these facts: [facts]. Ask for missing essentials and use synthesized music.

prompt_templates.title: Apply Brand Direction
prompt_templates.prompt: Plan a 45-second portrait demo for [product]. Use [brand assets], show [three features], and end with this approved URL: [URL].

prompt_templates.title: Review Before Final Rendering
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a timed beat sheet, editable HTML, contact sheet, and draft for [product]. Wait for approval before the final render.

prompt_templates.title: Refine a Detailed Workflow
prompt_templates.prompt: Build a 90-second landscape demo from [approved brief]. Show [five workflow steps], use [music file], and flag placeholders before rendering.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: coordinate a longer sequence and supplied audio.

output_examples.input: Plan a 60-second demo for a task manager with capture, assignment, and progress tracking.
output: 5-10 seconds: present the task coordination problem.
10-40 seconds: show capture, assignment, and progress tracking in three interface chapters.
40-57 seconds: summarize the workflow and show the supplied call to action.
57-60 seconds: hold the product name on the closing screen.

output_examples.input: Prepare review materials before exporting the final video.
output: Review package: editable HTML preview, contact sheet, and draft MP4.
Review notes: check text clipping, interface accuracy, camera framing, pacing, and audio balance.
Final package after approval: motion-blurred MP4 with audio and a separate silent copy.

best_practices: Supply verified product facts, approved branding, and the exact workflow before scripting.
Review contact sheets and a draft before starting the slower final render.
Use trusted HTML and a dedicated output folder; address the documented renderer risks before processing external inputs.
anti_patterns: Inventing customer counts, testimonials, offers, or integration support.
Treating reconstructed interface scenes as proof of actual product behavior.
Rendering untrusted HTML or reusing output paths that contain existing files.

faq.question: Which AI tools are supported?
faq.answer: The skill provides instructions for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code. Rendering still requires the local dependencies.

faq.question: What do I need to provide?
faq.answer: Provide the product name and description. A website, brand assets, feature list, and approved call to action improve accuracy.

faq.question: What files can the workflow produce?
faq.answer: It can produce editable HTML, a contact sheet, draft MP4, final MP4 with audio, and a silent MP4.

faq.question: Does it record my live application?
faq.answer: No. It rebuilds selected interface moments from product information and renders those animations.

faq.question: Can I use my own music?
faq.answer: Yes. Supply a music file, or use the default synthesized soundtrack with interface sound effects.

faq.question: Is the renderer suitable for untrusted files?
faq.answer: Not without hardening. It enables cross-file browser access, uses unescaped manifest paths, and recursively removes a predictable frame directory.
